text:
sara: Quick heads-up — planning a throughput probe for continuous-batching tuning tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need loadgen + rotation windows + max_tokens sweep + a quick PR review for the batching gating change. Volunteers?

kevin: I can take loadgen and the schedule. What's the target RPS and which model flavor?

sara: Target ~2k RPS sustained per pool on 8x GPU rack (8g-rtx profile). Model: opt-13b-8q (quantized). Baseline batch size 32, sweep sizes [8,16,32,64]. max_tokens sweep [256, 1024, 2048]. Measure p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and KV-cache hit.

maria: I can review the PR (PR #4721) for gating. Quick Q: does this change touch warmup/prefill behavior?

sara: Good question — it only adjusts enqueue policy heuristics; warmup/prefill code untouched. Still, let's include warmup flag in the smoke canary.

nate: loadgen-bot: noted. I'll spin the sampling eval hooks during the long runs.

jen: I'll own rotations and on-call coverage. Can we avoid Europe peak (approx 17:00 CET)? prefer keep 09:00-15:00 PT window.

kevin: Loadgen config I'll start with (WIP):
```
model: opt-13b-8q
concurrency: 4
rps_target: 2000
batch_sizes: [8,16,32,64]
max_tokens: [256,1024,2048]
duration_per_step: 10m
metrics: [p50_latency,p95_latency,tokens_per_s,gpu_util,kv_cache_hit]
smoke_warmup: true
```
Will add tiny-payload cases too for <16 token fallback.

sara: Thanks — maria can you ping me for PR review tomorrow 08:30 PT?

maria: Yep, 08:30 PT works. I'll also add an eval set for the quantized variant to check for regressions.

sara: Also we should validate fallback path: small-batch path for prompt lengths <16 tokens. Add a tiny payload test (lengths 8/12/16).

kevin: Adding tiny payload sweep: prompt_lengths [16,64,512]. Will include both prefix-cached and cold-cache runs.

ops-bot: Reminder: tag runs with `cb-q2-sweep`, add `bench-id` and link perf board.

maria: PR note: added unit test for `enqueuePolicy` and a changelog line. Also added a short integration smoke in staging.

nate: I'll run the offline sampling eval against maria's eval set during the mid window and post results.

jen: Rotation plan draft: 09:00-12:00 PT -> primary = kevin, backup = jen; 12:00-15:00 PT -> primary = nate, backup = sara. Canaries before each major step.

sara: Sounds good. Can we start with a single-rack canary for 15m, then go fleet if stable?

kevin: Canary = yes. I'll spin one rack, run 15m step, post logs and p50/p95. If green, I'll scale to 4 racks.

maria: Also request: run one quantized smoke to compare LM perplexity on the eval set (just to catch large drop).

kevin: Will capture eval metrics and push to perf dashboard. I'll post links in this thread when available.

sara: Action items recap:
- kevin: loadgen config + canary + full sweep + post logs/dashboard link
- jen: rotations + escalation/contact list
- maria: PR review + eval set + unit/integration checks
- nate: sampling eval during mid window
- ops-bot / loadgen-bot: tag runs `cb-q2-sweep` and attach bench-id
Please ping here once you go live. :thumbsup:

kevin: On it, starting config changes now. Will update thread with exact run IDs and dashboard links.

maria: I'll do PR review at 08:30 PT and leave notes.

jen: I'll update the on-call rota and post the contact matrix here.

sara: Thanks team — let's keep the canary conservative and prioritize safety.

kevin: ETA: canary ready in ~40m, will @here before starting.

ops-bot: Run scheduled: `bench-id: cb-2026-03-17-09-01`, uploader: kevin, tag: cb-q2-sweep.

kevin: Live canary started — logs: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/cb-2026-03-17-09-01 (will be private link). Posting quick p50 snapshot in 10m.

maria: Thanks — on PR comments now. :coffee:
